AlarmDescription: Alert 1 of 6. The API is not answering from the internet: the Route 53 health check on https://<api domain>/actuator/health/liveness has been unhealthy (or silent) for 3 consecutive minutes. Route 53 health-check metrics exist only in us-east-1, so this alarm and its SNS topic live there. Runbook: docs/PRODUCTION_OPERATIONS.md, Monitoring > First response > API down.
